name: smwpatches-thwomp-face-flip-fix
title: Thwomp Face Flip Fix
description:
This patch makes Thwomp's eyes follow Mario instead of always looking in the same direction. Doesn't have any effect if Mario is far off. Requested by Ddoomm10.

(Shiny Ninetales): Now, additionally to the SA-1 support and Asar conversion, has a define to choose which eye the Thwomps will close, the closest or the farest.
